label: text
text: In his speech yesterday in the House of Commons, Mr. Lloyd George stated quite clearly the extent to which Liberallism and Labour might co-operate.

label: text
text: The debate on the Address-in-Reply to the King's Speech had roamed widely over the question of "Public ownership and democratic control of essential services" demanded by Labour amendments.

label: text
text: The substance of Mr. Lloyd George's statement was that if by co-operation between the Liberals and Labour is meant the swallowing by Liberals of every form of nationalisation from the production of food to those industries which supply clothing and many of the necessaries of life and if by nationalisation is meant State control of banks and credit, and generally of all the activities of industry, then Liberalism can find no common ground of action.

label: text
text: Liberalism stands for enterprise, and initiative. If co-operation means the strengthening of initiative where private enterprise has failed by the resumption of State ownership in the cases of land and electricity, here the parties can fight the same battle.

label: text
text: The result of the debate was the defeat by 299 votes against 112 of the Labour declaration in favour of the public ownership and democratic control of essential services.

label: text
text: Mr. Lloyd George referred to a suggestion by a Conservative member that a conference of all the parties should be held on the subject of unemployment. With this he expressed hearty agreement.

MOTOR LINERS
(British Wireless Service)
Rugby, Feb. 6
In the face of the keenest continental competition, what is stated to be the biggest order for motor passenger liners placed in this country since the war has been brought back from America by Mr. McGovern, Managing Director of the Furness Shipbuilding Co. of Middlesborough.

label: text
text:
Mr. McGovern says that the Grace Line of New York has instructed him to build two 10,800 tons twin screw vessels. They are to be used on the passenger service between New York and Chile, via the Panama Canal, and will have a speed of 17 knots.
The motor machinery will comprise Sulzcr Diesel engines developing 10,000 horsepower.
